name: Install Android SDK
command: set -e; D=~/.local/share/open-teams-android; cd $D; export JAVA_HOME=$D/jdk17; U=$(curl -fsSL https://dl.google.com/android/repository/repository2-3.xml | grep -o 'commandlinetools-linux-[0-9]*_latest.zip' | head -1); echo $U; curl -fL -o clt.zip https://dl.google.com/android/repository/$U; mkdir -p sdk/cmdline-tools; rm -rf sdk/cmdline-tools/latest; unzip -q clt.zip -d sdk/cmdline-tools; mv sdk/cmdline-tools/cmdline-tools sdk/cmdline-tools/latest; yes | sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$D/sdk --licenses >/dev/null; sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=$D/sdk "platform-tools" "platforms;android-35" "build-tools;35.0.0" | tail -3; ls sdk
